purpose: Enforcement baselines for tools/ci/project_truth_ledger.py. Every commit after a lineage's baseline must carry a LOCAL_CHANGE_LEDGER.jsonl row whose diff digest matches and whose authorization ids cover every changed file. Commits at or before a baseline are not checked.
diff_recipe: sha256(git diff --binary --no-ext-diff --no-renames <parent_sha> <commit_sha> -- . ':(exclude)docs/project-state/LOCAL_CHANGE_LEDGER.jsonl'); first parent for merges
baseline_selection: verify without --baseline uses the lineage whose baseline_sha is an ancestor of HEAD with the fewest commits between it and HEAD. verify-pr starts at merge-base(base, HEAD), or at that baseline if the merge-base is older, and reports the skipped range as unenforced.

lineages.baseline_reason: First commit of Programme B on VAN (mission provenance record). Unit G6c wrote retroactive rows for every commit after it; unit G7 added supersession rows so each of those commits is covered.
VAN main at the 2026-09-29 mission start (MISSION_PROVENANCE_MEMORY_FABRIC_JEV_20260929.md). Programme A branches from it; unit G7 wrote rows for every commit after it.

ranges_without_rows.applies_to: both lineages (VAN main up to the Programme A baseline)

unenforced_history.rows_before_the_gap: The 27 schema_version 1 rows from the vanguduza-control pre-commit hook (2026-09-15 to 2026-09-18) carry staged_diff_sha256 digests whose recipe could not be reproduced (unit G6c). They are kept unchanged and are not verified.
unenforced_history.policy: No rows are fabricated for these commits. They were made without a ledger row and without a checker reading the ledger. This range is recorded as unenforced; it is not certified, and nothing in it is claimed to be owner-authorized by this file.
